nodes.name: 水碗验绳
who: the halfling judge with the brass ladle
nodes.light: pale morning light from high windows on the left, falling across a long black stone counter, the two halves of the room in cool shade
nodes.camera: at counter height, looking along the black stone toward the three on the bench, the dividing rope crossing the top of the frame, slightly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: an autumn morning in a long, bare inspection hall of timber and stone. A hemp rope is stretched from wall to wall above head height, dividing the hall in two; on the right half sit a dozen people in polished mail and white surcoats, on the left half a dozen horned and winged people in dark travelling leathers, the two sides glaring at each other. Across the middle runs a long counter of black stone, and behind it three judges are squeezed onto one short bench, all facing us. In the middle sits the halfling judge with the brass ladle, a tiny round-faced woman whose feet do not reach the floor, a long-handled brass ladle lying across her knees, both hands on it, her eyebrows raised. On her right sits the imperial law officer, a stern woman in a dark high-collared coat, her right hand on a string of shell counting-beads, her left hand flat on the counter. On her left sits a pale young man in white holding a lit white candle in both hands. In front of the counter, in full profile facing right, stands the lilac-haired rope-maker, a woman of nearly forty with pale lilac braids coiled round her head: her left hand holds a clay bowl of water on the counter, her right hand lifts a short dripping length of grey rope out of it, its strands untwisted, and she rubs it between finger and thumb. Beside her a nervous rope-seller wrings his cap. Far back on the left, a woman with garnet-red curls and black lace gloves claps her hands twice, smiling. Dust motes hang large and soft in the near corners.
nodes.note: 一幕对头头一手（源稿第135行）：茉德把那一截捻开，往水碗里一浸，说是麻染的；南妮说本庭不认嘴；罗丝玛笑着鼓了两下掌。三个人挤一条长凳、一根麻绳隔屋照开局。弥迦没列进 who，照文字写。

nodes.name: 红芯线
nodes.light: ash-white light leaking down from broken pipes far overhead, a sea-green glow on the shell at the right, the water black and mirror-still
nodes.camera: almost at water level, the reflections filling the lower half of the frame, looking across the room at the post, tilted
nodes.text: Scene: the middle of the night deep underground, in a vast old mine hall whose roof is too high to see. The floor is covered by clear still water, ankle-deep, and rows of roofless stone houses stand in it with walls only shoulder-high; yet in the reflection on the water every house has its roof whole. In one such house a post of black oak stands in the water, its foot crusted with dark red crystal; a grey reed rope is tied low on it with a knot hidden under white lime, and at the rope's other end a white sea-shell floats mouth-down, glowing faintly green. A creeper of blood-red thorns has crawled across the water along the reflections and wound itself round the rope; one of the rope's three strands is cut through. At this instant the apricot-haired squire, a girl of eighteen with a short ponytail and a grey feather behind her ear, in full profile facing left, flicks the thorn away with the point of a straight sword in her right hand, her left hand out for balance. Kneeling in the water at the post and facing us, the lilac-haired rope-maker grips the rope with both hands just below the cut and stares at the opened end: inside the grey strands runs one thin red core thread with a small lump in it. Behind the post, facing us, the bull-horned porter, a huge bronze-skinned man with copper caps on his forward-curving horns, stands with his eyes shut and his right hand closed round the top of the post, his left hand hanging. Far back in the doorway, a woman with garnet-red curls peels a black lace glove from her fingertips. Drops and ripples hang large and blurred in the near corners.
nodes.note: 二幕对头第二手（源稿第149行）：一丛血棘贴着倒影绞上了绳，三股割断了一股，让娜一剑把棘挑断，茉德扑过去攥住绳，断口里露出一根红芯线；比亚克一只手搭在桩上守着。屋顶塌了、倒影里屋顶好好的照第146行。

nodes.name: 碎灯
nodes.light: a burst of orange-white fire where the spear meets the lamp in the middle, lighting clouds of white steam from below, ash-grey gloom above and behind
nodes.camera: low in the flooded ditch behind the two captains, looking up along the spear at the lamp, strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: deep underground in a vast flooded mine hall, among rows of roofless stone houses standing in shallow water; fallen pit props lie across a waist-deep ditch, and rusted cart rails run under the water. Half the water in the ditch has just flashed into white steam. Out of the steam, in the middle of the picture, the apricot-haired knight captain lunges in full profile facing right: a tall young man in mail and a white surcoat, both hands driving a long spear forward, and the whole head of the spear is wrapped in orange fire. The spear point has just gone straight through a miner's lamp, and the lamp is bursting into sparks and shards. The lamp is held up by a tall grey shade in the shape of a mine overseer, a figure of dust and shadow with no face under its hood, a long iron counting-rod in its other hand; behind it a line of shadow shapes hauling shadow ore carts is stopping in mid-step and beginning to blow apart. Two steps behind the knight, also in full profile facing right, stands the indigo-haired fire-horn captain: long indigo-violet hair tied at the nape, two swept-back horns with crimson marks at the roots, both horns blazing like torches, his right arm stretched out toward the spear, feeding the fire that runs along it, his left hand pressed to a bruised shoulder. At the far left edge, small and half surrounded by shadows, a woman with garnet-red curls clutches a glowing white sea-shell to her chest. Overhead the broken pipes that leak light all dim at once. Steam, sparks and drops of water fly large and blurred across the near corners.
nodes.note: 三幕第六拍（源稿第158行）：贾斯珀的角火烧起来，半条沟的水腾成白汽，热拉尔借着汽冲到它跟前，角火裹上他的枪尖，一枪捅穿了那盏矿灯，灯一碎，拖矿车的影子一个接一个站住，散了。数灯的是督工的残响，写成兜帽底下没有脸。罗丝玛抱着螺被围住照第156行。

nodes.name: 牌绳
nodes.light: low golden late-autumn sun from the left, long shadows, a cool blue haze over the well mouth behind the cage
nodes.camera: from inside the cage looking out through the open gate at the two coming in, a slight tilt
nodes.text: Scene: a bright, cold day late in autumn at the mouth of the great well; far off, bells are ringing in two directions, and small flags hang on both sides of the lip for a day of remembrance. An iron lift cage stands open at the edge. Two young women are stepping into it side by side, facing us. On the left is the boatman's daughter, a sturdy girl with a coil of thin rope slung over her shoulder, and all along the rope hang small blank wooden tags that clack together; her right hand holds the cage door, her left hand steadies the coil. On the right is the apricot-haired squire, eighteen, her hair in a short ponytail, a grey feather tucked behind her ear, a straight sword at her hip, in plain travelling clothes with no surcoat; her right hand rests on the sword's pommel and her left hand is lifted to tuck the feather in more firmly. They are not smiling, but they look at each other like people who have agreed on something. Behind them at the winch a woman with a basket counts on her fingers. On a board beside the winch one small brass seal hangs on a nail among many wooden name-tags. Fallen leaves blow large and soft across the near corners.
nodes.note: 收束末一拍（源稿第171行）：同一天两边的钟还在响，婕西背着一卷牌绳，让娜耳后别着那根灰羽毛，两个人进了吊笼，下去找桑德。未归板上那枚旅印照第170行。婕西的样子照立绘。

nodes.line: 共约的年月·叠好的装备
nodes.name: 门槛回头
nodes.light: one warm lamp on the work table inside, the blue-grey of the hour before dawn in the lane outside the door
nodes.camera: from inside the shop behind the work table, looking past the mender's hands to the doorway, slightly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: the hour before dawn in a small mender's shop at the foot of a town wall. Shelves of folded cloth, spools of thread, a long work table with a lamp; mended coats and packs hang on poles under the eaves outside. A brass thimble is nailed to the open door. In the doorway, on the threshold, the honey-haired young swordsman has stopped and turned to face us: twenty-two, a curl of honey-coloured hair fallen over his forehead, a grey scarf wound twice round his neck with a small knot at each end, a sword hung at his right hip for a left-handed draw, a pack on his back. His left hand is raised, pushing the curl back; his right arm hangs at his side, and the sleeve at the right elbow is torn open two fingers long. He is grinning. In the near foreground, large and partly cut off by the frame, the mender sits at the table in full profile facing right: honey hair half gone white, coiled up and held with a knitting needle, a threaded needle held up in her right hand, her left hand flat on a folded coat; her mouth is firm, her eyes on the torn sleeve. Out in the lane beyond him, small, three companions wait: a winged girl crouching on the eaves opposite, a dwarf with two braids, a halfling hugging an account book. Lamp motes drift large and soft in the near corners.
nodes.note: 一幕第一拍（源稿第467行）：乔尔把灰围巾绕了两圈，在门槛上回头说二十天，袖子那天补，多琳说回来再补。右袖肘弯的口子、门上的铜顶针、巷口三个人照开局和第468行。他用左手拿剑，剑挂右边。

nodes.line: 共约的年月·叠好的装备
nodes.name: 林中叩门
nodes.light: green light dripping from the rims of giant mushroom caps overhead, one line of warm yellow lamplight from the crack of the door, deep blue-green dark between the stalks
nodes.camera: low on the moss carpet a few steps from the door, looking up at it among the towering stalks, tilted
nodes.text: Scene: night deep underground in a forest of giant mushrooms, their stalks as thick as towers, the rims of their caps hanging with green light. Among the stalks stand dozens of doors with no walls round them, each one a different household's front door on its own stone doorstep. In the middle stands one plain shop door with a brass thimble nailed to it, shut, a line of warm lamplight showing along its edge. The rust-haired dog-eared tracker kneels at it in full profile facing right, his nose and one pricked dog ear close to the crack: his right hand is flat on the door, his left hand holds a thin rope he has just knotted to the door handle, and his face is wide open with hope. Behind him, facing us, the grizzled map-drawer, plainly a middle-aged woman, short and sturdy, her back a little bent, her short hair grizzled grey and cut level with the ears, fine lines at her eyes and mouth exactly as in her reference, a charcoal stub behind her ear, crouches with a mallet in her right hand and a long iron nail in her left, her eyes on the ground under the doorstep. On the left, standing in full profile facing right, the silver-haired night-wing, a tall young man with deep blue swallow wings folded at his back, holds a lantern low in his right hand and an old child-sized coat over his left arm. The moss carpet under the doorstep has begun to bulge like something breathing, and the other doors around them stand at slightly different angles than doors should. Glowing spores drift large and blurred through the near corners.
nodes.note: 二幕第五、六拍（源稿第480、481行）：门林深处有人敲门，敲的是一扇钉着铜顶针的门，门缝里漏着灯光，邓肯隔着门缝闻见了乔尔；他刚把绳拴上门把，脚下的菌毯一拱。画的是门滑走以前的一瞬。乔尔十五岁穿小了的旧外套照第476行。｜11-25 第三手：第一稿梅布尔画成了二十来岁、褐发、看不出男女，跟立绘不像，改写重画。

nodes.line: 共约的年月·叠好的装备
nodes.name: 回针结
nodes.light: warm yellow lamplight spilling out through the half-open door onto his hands, green mushroom light on everything behind him, the two lights meeting on the coat
nodes.camera: close at the doorway at the height of the hands and the coat, the door frame cutting the right edge, tilted
nodes.text: Scene: deep underground in the forest of giant mushrooms, at a shop door that stands alone among the stalks with a brass thimble nailed to it. Four long iron nails have been driven through its stone doorstep into the rock, and the moss carpet all round is stretched tight as a drumhead. The door has opened a hand's width. In the gap, facing us, stands the mender in the doorway: a woman with honey hair half gone white coiled up on a knitting needle, a threaded needle pinched in her left hand, crow's-feet at her eyes, smiling gently, every detail right; with her right hand she holds a young man's coat out through the gap, folded so that the elbow of one sleeve lies uppermost, neatly patched. In front of the door, in full profile facing right, stands the rust-haired dog-eared tracker. His right hand, which was on the door handle, has come half away from it and rests on the patched elbow of the coat, the fingertips pressing flat; his left hand has gone to the cuff of his own right sleeve, thumb rubbing a small hard knot hidden in a mend there. His dog ears have gone flat back, and his face is changing from longing to something cold. Three steps behind him, facing us, the four-armed sea-blue-haired woman waits: cyan-green scales on her neck and forearms, one thick sea-blue braid, all four hands gripping an iron-bound battering ram held level at her hip, her jaw set. Beside her, small, a grizzled woman with a mallet kneels by the last nail, and three more young fighters stand each on a doorstep stone of other doors. Spores hang large and soft in the lamplight at the near corners.
nodes.note: 三幕对头第三手（源稿第489行）：门自己开了一道缝，多琳站在门里，手里捏着针，把乔尔那件外套从门缝里递出来，肘弯补好了；邓肯的手从门把上松开了半截，摸了一遍，平的，又摸了摸自己袖口上多琳补的那一处。应门的这一回顶着多琳的脸，照场面画她的脸。缇玛四只手抡破门槌是下一拍。

nodes.line: 共约的年月·叠好的装备
nodes.name: 长阶顶
nodes.light: clear morning sun from the left on the top of the stair, the stair itself falling away into cool blue shade behind them
nodes.camera: at the height of the low stool, close on the sleeve and the needle, the stair head behind, a slight tilt
nodes.text: Scene: a late-summer morning at the top of the long stone stair that climbs out of the great well. A low wooden stool stands on the top landing. On the stool sits the honey-haired young swordsman, facing us, thin and pale after weeks underground, a curl of hair over his forehead, in a shirt with no coat; his left hand rests on his knee, his right arm is held out to the side, and the shirt sleeve on that arm is torn in a short ragged line. Beside him, standing in full profile facing left and bent over the arm, the mender, honey hair half gone white and coiled on a knitting needle, sews the tear shut: her left hand pinches the cloth, her right hand draws a threaded needle through and up; her face is dry-eyed and stern, her lips pressed on a second needle. Behind them, just reaching the top step and facing us, the four-armed sea-blue-haired woman stands bowed under four full sets of gear tied on her back, four packs, four folded coats, weapons bundled beneath, one grey scarf folded square on top; her upper hands hold the straps at her shoulders and her lower hands hang open, her braid dark with sweat. A rust-haired dog-eared man stands at the swordsman's shoulder with one hand under his elbow. Sun-lit dust drifts large and soft in the near corners.
nodes.note: 收束第一、二拍（源稿第498、499行）：缇玛不肯放绞盘，背着四套东西走了长阶；长阶顶上多琳没有哭，按着他坐下，回来了，补。乔尔衬衣袖子上那道门缝犬咬的口子只写成布破了，不画伤。

nodes.line: 共约的年月·头一车三币
nodes.name: 封蜡龙鳞
nodes.light: white-gold afternoon light through the tall windows of a mint hall, bright on the silver and the wax, warm shade under the wagon
nodes.camera: close over the lid of the chest, level with the wax seal, the wagon and the mint behind, slightly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: a spring afternoon in the loading yard of a great mint, pale stone arcades all round. A big wagon with four mules stands ready, and on its bed sits an iron-bound chest, its lid just shut and locked. A fat seal of soft red wax has been poured over the lock. The iron-grey-scaled dragonborn woman stands at the chest in full profile facing right: frost-blue hair cut level with the ears, plates of iron-grey scales over both forearms. Her left forearm is held out bare, and one scale is missing from it, leaving a pale patch; her right hand presses that scale, a grey oval the size of a coin, down into the warm wax of the seal with her thumb. Her face is calm and serious. On the wagon seat above, facing us and leaning down to watch, sits the halfling wagon driver, a small young man with straw curls under an old leather cap, all ten fingers stained black with charcoal; his right hand holds a ring with one iron key, his left hand grips a small sketchbook against his knee, and his eyes are fixed on her scales. Behind the wagon, small, five more guards wait with their packs: a dwarf, a slender elf with a bow, a wolf-eared woman, a white-robed priest with small dark horns, a neat dark-haired man. On the roof of the wagon crouches a small iron-grey wyvern, wings folded. Bright dust floats large and soft in the near corners.
nodes.note: 一幕第五拍（源稿第803行）：造币署装箱，上了锁，钥匙交给驾车的，芬雅从左前臂剥下一片鳞，按进箱盖的封蜡里。迈洛十根指头是黑的、见面头一句要画她的鳞照第802行。铁哨蹲在车顶。

nodes.line: 共约的年月·头一车三币
nodes.name: 崖边后轴
nodes.light: hard white morning sun on snow from the upper right, the cliff side in deep blue shadow, a cloud of blown snow glittering in the light
nodes.camera: from out in the air beside the cliff, level with the road, looking back at the wagon hanging over the edge, strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: early morning on an old mountain road cut into a cliff, the rock wall on the left, a sheer drop on the right, spring snow on every ledge. At the narrowest point a big four-mule wagon has lost its rear axle: the axle has rusted clean through, the back wheels are folding outward, and the tail of the wagon with a heavy iron-bound chest on it is swinging out over the drop. The iron-grey-scaled dragonborn woman has thrown herself against the wagon on the cliff-edge side: in full profile facing left, her right shoulder and both hands driven flat into the side of the wagon bed, frost-blue hair whipped back, her boots sliding, two fresh furrows ploughed in the stone under her heels. Under the hanging tail of the wagon an iron-grey wyvern, no bigger than a horse, has just come up from below and taken the weight on its back, both wings fully spread and beating down; the wind of its wings is tearing the snow off half the mountainside in a huge white cloud that pours away down the slope. On the driver's seat, facing us, the halfling wagon driver, a small young man with straw curls under a leather cap, stands braced with both hands hauling the reins, his mouth open, still singing to the four mules, which lean into their collars with their hooves set. A dwarf is sliding on his back under the wagon bed with a hoop of bronze-gold metal in his hands. Snow and grit fly large and blurred across the near corners.
nodes.note: 二幕对头第二手（源稿第812行）：后轴锈穿了，车尾连着一万枚月银往崖外甩，芬雅平肩顶住车厢，靴底在石头上犁出两道沟，铁哨从崖下翻上来拿背托住车尾，翼风把半面山的积雪掀了下去，隆巴趴在车底拿山铜箍了一圈，迈洛的调子照第812行开头。

nodes.line: 共约的年月·头一车三币
nodes.name: 接车
nodes.light: a rust-red haze over the whole field with the afternoon sun burning dull orange through it, a streak of white-gold dragon fire low along the ground on the left
nodes.camera: low at the stone rail of the well mouth, looking up the sliding slope at the wagon coming down on us, strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: an afternoon in spring on the open field of fire below the great white wall, three miles of wheat ground that is now sliding like a landslide toward the stone rail of the well mouth; a cloud of red rust-dust miles long stands over it, and rusted arrowheads and blade fragments stick up out of the turned earth. A big four-mule wagon carrying three iron-bound chests has tipped over on the moving slope and is coming down on its side. The red-haired bull-horned baker has caught it: a tall bronze-skinned woman with short fiery red hair and two horns curving out to the sides, the left one notched, facing us with her back to the falling wagon bed, both arms stretched up and back and both hands spread under its side rail, holding the whole weight; both her legs are seen, braced wide, each ending in a cloven hoof that has ploughed its own long furrow in the earth, and the wagon has stopped an arm's length short of the stone rail in the foreground. A long-handled iron baker's peel, glowing red-hot, lies flung on the ground beside her. Under the wagon shaft, pinned but unhurt, the halfling wagon driver, a small young man with straw curls, lies on his back facing up, both hands still locked on the reins, his mouth open in song. On the left, in full profile facing left, the iron-grey-scaled dragonborn woman stands behind a tall shield planted in the earth, rust blooming on her scales, both hands on the shield's grips. Beyond her an iron-grey wyvern breathes a flat stream of fire along the ground, and under one of its claws a man in a grey cloak lies pressed into the soil, his left hand bare and open. Three children crouch behind the wagon wheel, unhurt. The red-brown on everyone's clothes is rust dust only: there is no blood on anyone, and the halfling's arms are clean. Rust flakes and sparks fly large and blurred across the near corners.
nodes.note: 三幕第六拍（源稿第823行）：车正往口子的石栏滑，迈洛压在辕底下，兹拉塔扔了铲，转身两只手托住倒下来的车帮，蹄子在土里犁出十几步长的两道沟，车停在石栏前一臂远；铁哨一只爪子把铜指套按回土里。射界腾起几里长的红雾照第821行。迈洛写成压着没受伤；三个孩子（山铜之冠）不受伤。raw 只管芬雅鳞上的锈和土。｜11-25 第三手：第一稿兹拉塔只画出一条腿，衣裳和半身人胳膊上的锈红像血，改写重画。

nodes.line: 共约的年月·头一车三币
nodes.name: 掰面包
nodes.light: warm noon sun in a busy street, bright on the bread and the faces, cool shade inside the hall door behind
nodes.camera: at the height of the loaf, close on her hands breaking it, the others in a half circle behind, a slight tilt
nodes.text: Scene: a spring noon in the crowded street in front of the guild's commission hall, a tall timber hall with its doors open. Beside the door is a baker's street stall with a basket of round loaves. In the middle, facing us, stands the red-haired bull-horned baker: a tall bronze-skinned woman with short fiery red hair, two horns curving out to the sides with flour on their tips, a notch filed in the left one. She holds one big round loaf in both hands at chest height and is breaking it in two, crumbs falling; she is almost smiling. On the stall-keeper's palm beside her lies one small bronze-gold coin, just paid. Around her in a half circle, hands held out, stand the rest of the wagon's company: on the left the halfling wagon driver, a small young man with straw curls and charcoal-black fingers, in full profile facing right, both hands cupped up; on the right the iron-grey-scaled dragonborn woman, frost-blue hair cut to the ears, in full profile facing left, her right hand out, her left forearm bandaged where a scale is missing; between them a dwarf, a slender elf, a wolf-eared woman, a white-robed priest with small dark horns and a neat dark-haired man, and in front three children, a white-haired dwarf girl, a boy with a hammer on his back and a halfling boy, all reaching up, unhurt and grinning. Above the hall door a workman is carrying away a big wooden board wiped blank. Crumbs and street dust drift large and soft in the near corners.
nodes.note: 收束第四拍（源稿第831行）：兹拉塔拿头一个便士在委托厅门口买了一个面包，掰给一车人和三个孩子。兑价板摘了照第825行。芬雅缺的那片鳞写成前臂缠着布。

nodes.name: 汤面在晃
who: the camp cook with the black iron pot
the old fire-horn with the stone hammer
nodes.light: a flat grey-white glow rising from the depth of the pit like the light before sunrise, one small cooking fire warm on the ledge, green points of drifting spores overhead
nodes.camera: on the ledge beside the pot, looking past it over the edge and down the straight stair, tilted
nodes.text: Scene: night deep underground on a flat ledge of old rock at the mouth of an immense pit; behind it a marsh of glowing mud and the stalks of giant mushrooms, overhead a sky of drifting green spores. From the ledge a single straight stair cut in the rock goes down along the pit wall, the wall on one side, black emptiness on the other, with no bottom in sight. Far down in that blackness a layer of grey-white light has begun to glow, as if day were about to break below. In the foreground the camp cook with the black iron pot kneels in full profile facing right beside a small fire: a woman of fifty-four, honey hair half white coiled on her head and pinned with a wooden spoon handle; her right hand holds a wooden ladle still, her left hand rests on the rim of a black iron pot set on the rock, and she is staring into it, where the surface of the soup trembles in rings though no one touches it. Behind her, standing in full profile facing left at a big boulder on the edge, the black-haired stone-carver hammers the last pin into a bronze-gold plaque fixed on the stone, mallet in her right hand, her left hand flat on the plaque, which bears two simple chiselled notches. At the head of the stair, seen directly from behind and looking down into the glow, stands the old fire-horn with the stone hammer: broad, ochre-skinned, two short straight black-tipped horns, a wooden tag on a cord at his neck, his right hand on the long hammer at his belt, his left hand hanging. Along the ledge a dozen porters are setting down their loads. Spores drift large and blurred through the near corners.
nodes.note: 一幕第六拍到幕终（源稿第1132到1134行）：娜丁放下锅，汤面在晃；卓娅把山铜牌钉上台边一块大石头；上旬二日夜里，阶顶往下的黑里亮起一层灰白的光，像天快亮了。牌上的二十写成两道刻痕，不画数字。

nodes.name: 影墙缺口
who: the old fire-horn with the stone hammer
nodes.light: a curtain of orange sparks across the top of the stair, a river of cold blue-white fire climbing the stair from below, the phantom wall pale grey and half transparent between them
nodes.camera: from a few steps down the stair, looking up at the gap in the wall and the man standing in it, strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: deep underground at the head of a straight rock stair on the wall of an immense pit. Across the top of the stair stands a wall of white stone twice a man's height that is only an image of light: pale, half transparent, with battlements, and with one gap in the middle exactly over the top step. In the gap stands the dim shade of an old archer with white hair, a hardwood bow in his hands; behind the battlement a second shade, a silent middle-aged man, waits. Standing in the same gap, in the very place of the old archer so that the shade's white hair falls across his chest, is the old fire-horn with the stone hammer, facing us and looking down the stair: broad, ochre-skinned, two short straight black-tipped horns, a wooden tag at his neck. His right hand has just struck the head of his long hammer against the tip of his own left horn, and a spray of orange sparks leaps from it and falls across the steps like a curtain; his left hand hangs clenched. On the top step at his feet is one small round black seal mark. Below him the stair is covered with frost, and a river of cold blue-white fire is flowing up it, step by step, and has stopped three steps under his boots. Far down, small, at the first landing, stands the thing that sends it: a tall horned shape with no face, two long horns burning with white cold flame, a tide of crawling horned and tailed shapes packed on the stair behind it. On the ledge behind the wall, kneeling in full profile facing left, the black-haired stone-carver cuts into the top step beside the black mark with chisel and mallet. Sparks and frost crystals fly large and blurred through the near corners.
nodes.note: 二幕第三拍和对头头一手（源稿第1140、1142行）：塔隆走进缺口，站在老人的影子站着的地方，拿锤头在角尖上一敲，火星泼出去；把山铜旅印按在最上面那一级；冷火顺着石阶淌上来，他一锤砸在脚前，火星连成一道火帘，霜停在他脚下三级。两拍并成一个场面。霜炬不画脸。

nodes.name: 横纹一锤
who: the old fire-horn with the stone hammer
nodes.light: a line of small orange fires burning all the way down the pit wall on the left, the hammer head white-hot at the centre, blue-white cold fire falling away into the black on the right, a green snow of spores coming down from above
nodes.camera: at the top step, level with the hammer head as it lands, looking down the stair along the line of fires, strongly tilted
nodes.text: Scene: the small hours of the night deep underground, at the head of a straight rock stair on the wall of an immense pit. Dozens of burning arrows stand stuck in the pit wall along the stair, one after another all the way down, making a narrow path of firelight against the rock. At the top, in the gap of a pale phantom wall, the old fire-horn with the stone hammer is at the bottom of his swing, in full profile facing right: broad, ochre-skinned, two short straight horns whose cracked tips burn with real flame, his left sleeve torn and his left forearm split with frost cracks; both hands on the long haft, the white-hot hammer head has just landed sideways on the second step from the top. That one step has broken clean off along a cross-grain and is dropping into the pit, and with it falls the thing that stood on it: a tall horned shape with no face, its two long horns streaming blue-white cold fire, one hoof still on the falling stone, a whole tide of crawling shapes spilling off the stair after it. The crack from the blow runs on down the pit wall out of sight, and from far above a snow of green glowing spores is shaken loose and falling through the whole picture. Lying flat on the top step, in full profile facing right, the black-haired stone-carver presses her left palm on the rock beside the hammer head, her right hand gripping the edge. On the left, hugging the lit wall just below the missing step and facing us, the mint-haired tiefling girl, seventeen, with small gold-tipped horns and a brass seal on a cord round her neck, reaches up with both hands, unhurt; behind her, two more children press to the wall, one holding the other up. Embers, frost and green spores whirl large and blurred through the near corners.
nodes.note: 三幕第七拍（源稿第1154行）：塔隆一锤横着落在卓娅按着的地方，霜炬连着脚下那一级翻进了深窟，冷火一路往下灭；沃妮的火箭贴壁那一线从阶顶一路亮到头一处平台，三个孩子贴着壁往上挪；孢子星空震落像下了一场绿的雪。塔隆角尖裂缝里的火、左臂冻裂的口子照第1154、1155行（raw 只管他）。蒂芙十七岁，三个孩子不受伤，朗尼腿上那一刀不画。霜炬不画脸。

nodes.name: 掌心的印
who: the old fire-horn with the stone hammer
nodes.light: soft grey autumn daylight at the well mouth, a faint warm glow from the crystals in the shaft behind the cage
nodes.camera: close at the height of the two hands, his open palm and her small fist above it, the cage behind, a slight tilt
nodes.text: Scene: a grey autumn day at the mouth of the great well. An iron lift cage has just come up and stands open at the lip, and tired, dusty people are stepping out of it past a clerk with a ledger. In the foreground, the red-haired tiefling guild master stands in full profile facing right: dark red hair in one tail, two swept-back horns with a copper ring on the left one, a grey cloak; his right hand is held out flat, palm up. In front of him, in full profile facing left, stands the mint-haired tiefling girl, seventeen, small, her mint-green hair hacked short, small gold-tipped horns, a long thin tail with a yellow ribbon hanging still; her face is dirty and dry-eyed and very straight. With her right hand she is laying a small round brass seal on a cord into his palm; her left hand is closed tight on the empty cord at her own neck. Behind her, facing us, stands the old fire-horn with the stone hammer, his left arm bound in a sling, the tips of his two short horns split by fine glowing cracks, his eyes lowered. Two more children stand at his side, one leaning on a crutch, both looking at the seal. On the wall of the hall behind them hangs a tall board of names. Fine dust drifts large and soft in the near corners.
nodes.note: 收束第一拍（源稿第1160行）：二十八个人出了吊笼，他问几个，塔隆说少一个；蒂芙把芒戈的旅印放在他手心，他合上手。画的是合手以前。朗尼写成拄拐，不画伤。

notes: 罗丝玛、铜指套、沃妮、苏尔嘉、热拉尔以外的金马刺和夜不归的人没有立绘，照文字写。罗丝玛的样子照开局：石榴红卷发、黑纱手套。
数灯的（督工的残响）、霜炬、应门的门缝犬照大敌线的口径不画脸；q2_b3 应门的顶着多琳的脸，是场面写明的，照画。
q2_d2 把走进缺口敲角和第二夜的火帘并成一个场面。q2_d1 层碑上的二十画成两道刻痕。
